visual_text: Has the person had a way to answer?
Supports that can help, from research on people with aphasia.
Stipinovich et al 2023; Kim et al 2020
alt_text: Illustrative annotated bedside scene. An older man with aphasia after a stroke sits attentively in a chair. On the table in front of him are a pad of key words and picture cards of options. An assessor with a notepad and a speech and language therapist stand by. Pins: 1 key words written down, 2 pictures of the options, 3 a trained conversation partner, 4 more time.
